turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello! How have you been lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How much should I spend on gifts for my coworkers?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most people keep it small, around ten to fifteen dollars each. Nobody expects much at work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do I need to get one for my boss too?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's usually not expected. If you want to, a card or a group gift from the team is safest.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was going to bake cookies for everyone

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not at all, homemade cookies are often the favorite. Put them in little tins and they look really thoughtful.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How many should I put in each one?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Six to eight is plenty. Maybe mix two kinds so it feels like a treat.
